customer_problem.problem_statement: Adjusters spend too much time assembling evidence-linked claim summaries across fragmented systems, causing slow handling, rework, and incomplete audit evidence.
customer_problem.business_outcome: Reduce handling time and rework while improving quality and citation completeness without allowing unauthorized protected actions.
customer_problem.scope: Retrieve effective policy evidence, produce a cited summary, and recommend request_evidence, continue_review, or escalate.
non_goals: Autonomously approve or deny a claim
Send customer communication or update the claims system without human approval

evidence: Reviewed evaluation set segmented by claim type and failure mode

assumptions.assumption: Effective-date and jurisdiction metadata remain complete for each rollout wave.
assumptions.test: Block a jurisdiction when policy metadata coverage is below 100 percent.

assumptions.assumption: Licensed adjusters retain decision authority and review cited evidence.
assumptions.test: Monitor acceptance, overrides, approval identity, and audit completeness weekly.

value_hypothesis.statement: If adjusters receive a source-linked summary and a bounded recommendation inside their workflow, then average handling time and rework will fall without reducing quality or safety.
